svg.title: Standard Supervised ViT vs. OpenAI CLIP ViT: Six Architectural Modifications
svg.desc: Side-by-side comparison between Dosovitskiy et al. (2020) standard supervised Vision Transformer and Radford et al. (2021) OpenAI CLIP Vision Transformer highlighting 6 architectural modifications: bias-free patch Conv2d, extra Pre-Encoder LayerNorm (ln_pre) before Block 1, QuickGELU activation, zero dropout with (2L)^-0.5 residual scaling, ln_post + bias-free multimodal linear projection W_i + L2 normalization, and 336px 2D bicubic position interpolation.
svg.text: Standard Supervised ViT (Dosovitskiy et al., 2020) vs. OpenAI CLIP ViT (Radford et al., 2021)
Six surgical architectural modifications turn a supervised ImageNet classifier into a stable 400M-pair multimodal contrastive vision tower
STANDARD SUPERVISED ViT (Dosovitskiy et al., ICLR 2021)
OPENAI CLIP ViT (Radford et al., ICML 2021)
1. Patch Extraction Stem (with bias)
conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, d, kernel_size=P, stride=P, bias=True)
Additive per-channel bias b ∈ ℝ^d included on patch projection.
1. Bias-Free Patch Extraction Stem (bias=False)
conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, d, kernel_size=P, stride=P, bias=False)
Bias is redundant because ln_pre centers tokens right after + E_pos.
MOD 1
2. Token Entry into Transformer Block 1 (No Pre-LN)
z₀ = Dropout([x_cls ; PatchEmb(I)] + E_pos)
Residual stream enters Block 1 with unnormalized sum variance.
2. Extra Pre-Encoder LayerNorm: ln_pre (Critical in CLIP)
z₀ = ln_pre([x_cls ; PatchEmb(I)] + E_pos)
Normalizes residual stream BEFORE Block 1; stabilizes contrastive Q·Kᵀ.
MOD 2
3. Encoder MLP Nonlinearity: Exact GELU
Standard Gaussian Error Linear Unit inside 4d FFN expansion.
3. Encoder MLP Nonlinearity: QuickGELU
QuickGELU(x) = x * sigmoid(1.702 * x)
Fast sigmoid approximation inherited from OpenAI GPT codebase.
MOD 3
4. Regularization & Weight Init (Supervised Regime)
dropout = 0.1 | Xavier / truncated normal init
Needs dropout & Mixup/RandAugment to avoid overfitting on 1.28M/14M images.
4. Zero Dropout & GPT-2 Residual Scaling (400M Web Pairs)
Scales MSA & MLP output projections by 1/√(2L) so residual variance stays O(1).
MOD 4
5. Output Head: Closed-Set Class Logits
logits = Linear(d → K)(LN(z_L[:, 0]))
Fixed K-way classification head (e.g. K=1000) discarded on transfer.
5. Output Head: ln_post + Bias-Free W_i + L2 Normalization
v = ln_post(z_L[:, 0]) @ W_i ; î = v / ||v||₂ ∈ 𝕊^(d_e - 1)
Projects d_i→d_e (768→512 or 1024→768) onto shared text-image hypersphere.
MOD 5
6. Supervised Fine-Tuning Resolution Boost (384×384)
Fine-tunes K-class head at 384² via 2D bicubic interpolation of E_pos[1:].
6. Contrastive High-Res Adaptation: ViT-L/14@336px
1 epoch at 336² (16×16=256 → 24×24=576 patches, 577 tokens) with interpolated E_pos.
MOD 6
